questions.stem: 成年年齡（age of majority）已降為十八歲，使年輕人比過去更早就能申辦信用卡和貸款。
questions.answer: The age of majority has been lowered to 18, enabling young people to apply for credit cards and loans earlier than before.
accepted_answers: The age of majority has been reduced to 18, allowing young people to apply for credit cards and loans at a younger age than before.
The age of majority has been lowered to eighteen, making it possible for young people to get credit cards and loans earlier than in the past.

questions.stem: 然而，自己簽約也代表必須承擔他們過去不必面對的財務與法律後果。
questions.answer: However, signing contracts on their own also means bearing financial and legal consequences that they did not have to face before.
accepted_answers: However, signing contracts by themselves also means taking on financial and legal consequences that they never had to face in the past.
However, signing contracts independently also means having to bear the financial and legal consequences which they did not need to face before.

1.explanation_zh: 「成年年齡已降為十八歲」是已經完成的改變，用現在完成式被動 The age of majority has been lowered to 18。「使年輕人…」是這項改變帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 enabling／allowing young people to …（enable／allow + 人 + to VR）。「比過去更早」是比較級 earlier than before，放在句尾。「申辦信用卡和貸款」是 apply for credit cards and loans，apply 要接 for，兩個名詞泛指時用複數。
1.strategy_zh: 看到「已」想完成式；「使…」接在整句後面表結果時用逗號＋V-ing；「比過去更…」用比較級＋than before。
hints: 切成四段：成年年齡已降為十八歲／使年輕人／比過去更早／就能申辦信用卡和貸款
標的詞彙：age of majority（成年年齡）、lower（調降）、young（年輕的）、enable（使能夠，也可用 allow）、earlier（更早）、apply for（申辦）、credit card（信用卡）、loan（貸款）
句型框架：S + has been lowered to 18, enabling + O + to VR … + earlier than before

2.explanation_zh: 「自己簽約」是一個動作，當主詞用動名詞 Signing contracts on their own，動詞用單數 means。「代表必須承擔」是 means bearing／taking on（mean + V-ing 表示「意味著」；mean to VR 是「打算」）。「他們過去不必面對的後果」修飾語在前，英文用關係子句放在名詞後面：consequences (that) they did not have to face before，關係代名詞是 face 的受詞，可以省略，後面不要再加 them。「財務與法律後果」是 financial and legal consequences。
evidence: 自己簽約也代表必須承擔
他們過去不必面對的財務與法律後果
2.strategy_zh: 動作當主詞→動名詞；「…的＋名詞」而修飾語有自己的主詞→受格關係子句（that 可省略）。
hints: 切成四段：然而，自己簽約／也代表必須承擔／他們過去不必面對的／財務與法律後果
標的詞彙：sign（簽）、contract（契約）、on their own（自己）、mean（代表）、bear（承擔，也可用 take on）、face（面對）、financial（財務的）、legal（法律的）、consequence（後果）
句型框架：However, V-ing … also means V-ing + N + (that) + S + did not have to face before

bonus.text: With the age of majority lowered to 18, young people are now able to apply for credit cards and loans earlier than ever before.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 with + 受詞 + 過去分詞（附帶狀況）交代背景，再接主要子句；earlier than ever before 加強語氣。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「已降為十八歲」說的是已經完成的改變，用現在完成式被動 has been lowered to 18；「使年輕人…」承接前面整件事，用句尾分詞 enabling／allowing young people to …，不另起一句；「比過去更早」是 earlier than before，放在動詞片語後面。
1.notes_zh: 本組依批次規格「同一組兩句的句型可以對調」把 PART＋COMP 放在第 1 句。第 2 部分寫成非限定關係子句 , which allows／enables young people to … 或 , which means (that) young people can … 也表達同一個「前面整件事造成的結果」，算作 PART 的可接受寫法（這時第 4 部分寫 can apply for …，已列入 accepted）。寫成 so young people can … 是對等子句，不在可接受寫法內。「成年年齡」題目已附 age of majority，寫 the age of adulthood 也可以。

common_errors.wrong: that they did not have to face them before
common_errors.right: that they did not have to face before
common_errors.explanation_zh: 關係代名詞 that 已經是 face 的受詞，後面不要再加 them。

common_errors.wrong: that they do not have to face before
common_errors.right: that they did not have to face before
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「過去不必面對」說的是過去，用過去式 did not have to（或 never had to）。

accepted: financial and legal consequences
the financial and legal consequences
legal and financial consequences
the legal and financial consequences

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾名詞要用形容詞：financial（財務的）、legal（法律的）。
「後果」泛指多種情況，用複數 consequences。

traps.literal_error: However, sign contracts on their own also means …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用「自己簽約」這個動作當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Signing contracts on their own，否則會變成祈使句。
「財務與法律後果」是抽象名詞片語，要寫成形容詞＋名詞 financial and legal consequences，不要把「財務」「法律」直接寫成名詞 finance、law。

bonus.text: However, with the freedom to sign contracts on their own comes the burden of financial and legal consequences that they never had to face before.
bonus.explanation_zh: 介系詞片語 with … 置首、主詞 the burden 移到動詞 comes 後面（地方副詞片語置首倒裝），凸顯「自由伴隨負擔」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「自己簽約也代表…」中文以動作當主詞，英文寫成動名詞主詞 Signing contracts on their own also means …；mean 後面接動名詞 bearing（mean to VR 是「打算」）；「他們過去不必面對的後果」修飾語在前，英文改成 consequences (that) they did not have to face before。
2.notes_zh: 第 2 部分寫成 also means (that) they must／have to bear … 也可以（means 後面接 that 子句）。第 3 部分 that／which 可省略；did not have to、never had to、have never had to 都表達「過去不必」。「自己」寫 on their own、by themselves、independently，或依上下文寫 without their parents' consent 都可以。

1.translation: The age of majority has been lowered to eighteen, allowing young people to apply for credit cards and loans earlier than before.
1.explanation_zh: 「已降為」用現在完成式被動 has been lowered to；「使年輕人能…」用分詞構句 allowing … to；「比過去更早」用 earlier than before；「申辦」用 apply for。

2.translation: However, signing contracts on their own also means that they must bear financial and legal consequences that they did not have to face in the past.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞 signing contracts 當主詞，「代表」用 means；「他們過去不必面對的後果」用關係子句 that they did not have to face in the past；「承擔後果」用 bear the consequences。

1.translation: The age of majority has been lowered to eighteen, enabling young people to apply for credit cards and loans earlier than they could in the past.
1.explanation_zh: 「已降為」用現在完成被動 has been lowered to；「使年輕人……能」用分詞構句 enabling ... to apply for；「比過去更早」用 earlier than they could in the past。

2.translation: However, signing contracts on their own also means having to bear the financial and legal consequences that they did not have to face in the past.
2.explanation_zh: 「自己簽約」用動名詞 signing contracts on their own 當主詞；「代表」用 means；「承擔……後果」用 bear the consequences；「過去不必面對」用 did not have to face in the past 放在關係子句中。
